contractRules.dte: Prefer 18–30 months; minimum 12–24+ months when liquidity dictates.
contractRules.delta: Target ~0.70–0.85; higher delta for conservative stock-like exposure.
contractRules.openInterest: Prefer ≥100, strong ≥500; avoid thin contracts unless spread/market depth is demonstrably good.
contractRules.spread: Prefer bid/ask width ≤5% of midpoint; ≤3% is better.
contractRules.breakeven: Prefer expiration breakeven roughly ≤20% above the underlying for high-probability profiles, adjusted for time and growth.
contractRules.iv: Avoid panic-volatility overpayment. Compare IV to the stock's own recent IV regime before buying.
contractRules.earnings: Avoid opening/adding immediately before earnings unless the event risk is deliberately part of the plan.
contractRules.management: Manage the thesis on the underlying first; do not let an option quote alone dictate averaging.
